pick.headline: US fighters intercept the Achille Lauro hijackers' plane
pick.summary: On October 10, 1985, US Navy F-14s intercepted an Egyptian airliner carrying the Achille Lauro hijackers and forced it to land at Sigonella, Sicily.
pick.significance: The interception was a rare successful use of force against terrorists, but provoked a standoff with Italy, which let Abu al-Abbas leave.
pick.fbis: The Middle East & South Asia review of October 11, 1985, led with the interception of the hijackers' plane: Egypt "greatly regrets" the US action, Rabin welcomed Reagan's decision, and Rome radio reported US-Italian differences over custody.
